meta.name: mem-search
meta.description: This skill should be used when the user asks to "search memory", "what do you remember about X", "check claude-mem", "mem search", "find past observations", "what did we do last session", or wants prior-session context about a project, decision, file, or task. Searches the user's Claude-Mem (cmem.ai) memory.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 搜索历史记忆，找回之前的对话和项目背景
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果经常需要查阅过去的会话记录来继续工作。
copy.tagline_en: Search past memories to retrieve prior conversations and project context.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to look back at previous chat records to continue your work.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会先用 search 工具搜索你跨会话的记忆库,再用 timeline 看前后上下文,最后只对筛选出的记录调 get_observations 取详情。
howto.when: 当用户问起之前会话的内容,比如“上次怎么解决的”“上周发生了什么”,或明确说“搜索记忆/查 claude-mem”时触发。

say.text: 帮我搜一下之前关于登录认证的记录
say.note: 会先返回带 ID 的搜索结果列表。

say.text: 上次那个 bug 最后怎么修的?查一下记忆
say.note: 会搜索 bugfix 类观察并给时间线。

say.text: 把最近一周的项目进展调出来看看
say.note: 按日期范围搜索观察记录。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude searches the cross-session memory index, inspects surrounding timeline context, then fetches details only for the records you select.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask about previous sessions, e.g. “how did we fix this last time?”, “what happened last week?”, or say “search memory”/“check claude-mem”.

say_en.text: Search my memory for records about login authentication.
say_en.note: Returns a result list with IDs first.

say_en.text: How did we fix that bug last time? Check memory.
say_en.note: Searches bugfix observations and shows a timeline.

say_en.text: Show me project progress from the last week.
